body.en: Arithmetic operators: + addition, − subtraction, * multiplication, / division (always gives a float), // floor division (quotient rounded down), % modulus (remainder) and ** exponent. Relational operators compare two values and give True or False: ==, !=, >, <, >= and <=. The + operator also joins strings, and * repeats a string.

Relational operators compare two values and give True or False: ==, !=, >, <, >= and <=. The + operator also joins strings, and * repeats a string.
narration.kn: ಅಂಕಗಣಿತ ನಿರ್ವಾಹಕಗಳು: +, −, *, / (ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ float), // (ಭಾಗಲಬ್ಧ, ಕೆಳಗೆ ಪೂರ್ಣಾಂಕ), % (ಶೇಷ), ** (ಘಾತ). ಸಂಬಂಧ ನಿರ್ವಾಹಕಗಳು ==, !=, >, <, >=, <= ಹೋಲಿಸಿ True ಅಥವಾ False ನೀಡುತ್ತವೆ.

title.en: Assignment, logical, identity and membership operators

body.en: Assignment operators store values: =, and shortcuts such as +=, −=, *=, /=, //=, %= and **=; x += 3 means x = x + 3. Logical operators and, or and not combine conditions. Identity operators is and is not check whether two names refer to the same object. Membership operators in and not in check whether a value is present in a sequence.

points.en: in, not in: is the value in the sequence?

narration.kn: ನಿಯೋಜನೆ ನಿರ್ವಾಹಕಗಳು: =, +=, −= …; x += 3 ಎಂದರೆ x = x + 3. ತಾರ್ಕಿಕ ನಿರ್ವಾಹಕಗಳು and, or, not. ಗುರುತು ನಿರ್ವಾಹಕಗಳು is, is not ಒಂದೇ ವಸ್ತುವೇ ಎಂದು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಸದಸ್ಯತ್ವ ನಿರ್ವಾಹಕಗಳು in, not in.
